description_en: Queries the detailed configuration, credential configuration status, publish status, and region of a specified model connection
description_zh: 查询指定模型连接的详细配置、凭据配置状态、发布状态和所属地域
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore get-model-connection --workspace-id ws-1 --connection-id mc-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetModelConnection

schema.description_en: The model text response returned when model testing succeeds. This value is empty when testing fails
schema.description_zh: 模型调试成功时返回的模型文本响应；调试失败时为空

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of SUCCESS indicates success
code.description_zh: 业务状态码。成功时为 SUCCESS

apiKeyCount.description_en: The number of API keys configured for the model connection
apiKeyCount.description_zh: 模型连接中已配置的 API Key 数量

apiKeys.description_en: The list of API keys used to access the upstream model service. The list contains at least one non-empty value
apiKeys.description_zh: 用于访问上游模型服务的 API Key 列表，至少包含一个非空值

items.description_en: The business value of this field

createdAt.description_en: The time when the resource was created, in RFC 3339 UTC format
createdAt.description_zh: 资源创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

credentialConfigured.description_en: Indicates whether access credentials have been configured for the model connection
credentialConfigured.description_zh: 是否已为模型连接配置访问凭据

description.description_en: The model connection description. The description can be up to 255 characters in length
description.description_zh: 模型连接描述，最长 255 个字符

endpoint.description_en: The absolute HTTP or HTTPS address of the upstream model service. The address can be up to 1024 characters in length
endpoint.description_zh: 上游模型服务的绝对 HTTP 或 HTTPS 地址，最长 1024 个字符

name.description_en: The model connection name. The name must be 1 to 128 non-whitespace characters in length
name.description_zh: 模型连接名称，长度为 1～128 个非空白字符

protocol.description_en: The model invocation protocol. Currently, only OpenAI/v1 is supported. If this parameter is not specified in Settings when the model connection is created, this default value is used
protocol.description_zh: 模型调用协议。当前仅支持 OpenAI/v1，创建模型连接时未设置则使用该默认值

regionId.description_en: The region ID of the resource

status.description_en:
The resource status. Valid values:
Creating: The resource is being created.
Active: The resource is available.
Failed: The resource creation or update failed.
Updating: The resource is being updated.
Deleting: The resource is being deleted

statusReason.description_en: The failure summary returned when the model connection fails to be published or fails to be deleted but remains in the Deleting state. This value is empty for other statuses
statusReason.description_zh: 模型连接发布失败，或删除失败但仍处于删除中时返回的失败摘要；其他状态为空

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the resource was last updated, in RFC 3339 UTC format
updatedAt.description_zh: 资源最后更新时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. A value of 200 indicates success

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
